action.name: Escape Combat
action.keywords: escape flee chase disengage run away getaway bridge piloting

test.dice: {Vehicle: Skill} + {Vehicle: Speed} v. fastest enemy craft's Piloting + Speed
test.bonusstring: Opposed piloting check plus speed against the fastest enemy craft. Net hits accumulate toward escaping combat.

action.notes: You need 6 accumulated net hits to completely escape combat. Only possible if you have movement left. Enemy Pursue Target net hits reduce your accumulated escape net hits.

action.name: Evasive Manoeuvres
action.keywords: evasive maneuvers manoeuvres dodge evade jink reposition vehicle defense bridge piloting

test.dice: {Vehicle: Skill} + {Vehicle: Handling} v. opposing pilot's Piloting + Handling
test.bonusstring: Opposed piloting check plus handling to change relative position; the result works as the vehicle's dodge test for the next round.

action.notes: Only possible if you have movement left. The book does not state exactly what the opposition rolls; assumed the opposing craft's piloting + handling.

action.name: Pursue Target
action.keywords: pursue chase follow hunt tail catch up bridge piloting

test.dice: {Vehicle: Skill} + {Vehicle: Speed} v. fastest enemy craft's Piloting + Speed
test.bonusstring: Opposed piloting check plus speed against the fastest enemy craft. Your net hits reduce your opponent's accumulated escape net hits.

action.notes: Only possible if you have movement left.

action.name: Inspire Department
action.keywords: inspire leadership captain rally morale department crew bonus

test.bonusstring: Leadership test; adds dice pool to the entire chosen department for a turn.

action.notes: The book only says "leadership test"; standard SR5 Charisma + Leadership [Social] assumed. The size of the bonus is not specified (presumably hits).

action.name: Crash Systems
action.keywords: crash systems crash program comms hacking disable ship system matrix attack

test.bonusstring: Opposed Crash Program test against a specified system: it suffers a negative modifier equal to your net hits; on double the needed net hits the system is disabled entirely for net-hits turns.

action.notes: The book says "opposed crash program test"; the pool and opposition are the SR5 core Crash Program test (Cybercombat + Logic [Attack] v. Intuition + Firewall).

action.name: DCM
action.keywords: dcm matrix perception targeting comms sensors fire control attack bonus

test.bonusstring: Opposed Matrix Perception test; add your net hits to every attack dice pool made by your vehicle this turn.

action.notes: The book says "opposed matrix Perception test"; pool and opposition are the SR5 core Matrix Perception test (Computer + Intuition [Data Processing] v. Logic + Sleaze).

action.name: Sensor Ghost
action.keywords: sensor ghost hide stealth jamming comms dodge decoy

test.dice: {Electronic Warfare} + {INT} v. searcher's Intuition + Data Processing
test.bonusstring: Opposed Hide test; add your net hits to the ship's dodge for a turn.

action.notes: The book says "opposed hide test"; pool and opposition are the SR5 core Hide matrix action (Electronic Warfare + Intuition [Sleaze] v. Intuition + Data Processing).

action.name: Boost Engines
action.keywords: boost engines speed overdrive engineering mechanic thrust

test.bonusstring: Appropriate mechanics test; increase vehicle speed for hits above 5, up to +2.

action.notes: "Appropriate mechanics test": use the mechanic skill matching the vehicle (the formula takes your best of Automotive/Aeronautics/Nautical Mechanic). Logic + skill [Mental] is the SR5 default for mechanic tests. Each hit above 5 gives +1 Speed, maximum +2.

action.name: Damage Control
action.keywords: damage control repair hull hit points engineering mechanic fix heal ship

test.bonusstring: Appropriate mechanics test; on a success repair lost hit points equal to hits x1 (fighter hull), x2 (frigate), x3 (cruiser) or x4 (capital-class hull).

action.notes: Each attempt after the first in a fight increases the difficulty by 2 (base difficulty not stated). Use the mechanic skill matching the vehicle.

action.name: Emergency Repairs
action.keywords: emergency repairs fix disabled system degraded drive engineering mechanic

test.dice: {LOG} + {Max: {Automotive Mechanic} or {Aeronautics Mechanic} or {Nautical Mechanic}} v. degradation difficulty
test.bonusstring: Appropriate mechanics test versus degradation difficulty; on a success a disabled system is repaired or a damage-degraded drive has its rating increased by 1.

action.notes: Destroyed systems cannot be fixed this way. Use the mechanic skill matching the vehicle.

action.name: Fire All Guns
action.keywords: fire all guns broadside gunnery shoot attack weapons volley vehicle weapon

test.bonusstring: Gunners fire all weapons mounted on the ship, designating targets as they wish.

action.notes: Only for large crews, an AI or a jacked-in rigger. All ranged combat from fixed vehicle weaponry uses Gunnery. Agility + Gunnery [Accuracy] is the SR5 manual default (jumped-in riggers use Logic in core SR5). DCM net hits add to this pool.

action.name: Fire One Weapon
action.keywords: fire one weapon gunnery shoot attack gun turret vehicle weapon

test.bonusstring: A gunner fires a single ship's weapon of their choice.

action.notes: Can be a called shot (see Called Shot entries). DCM net hits add to this pool.

action.name: Called Shot: Ship Section
action.keywords: called shot vehicle ship section gunnery target system

test.bonusstring: Fire One Weapon targeting a ship's section at -2. If damage gets through, the system is disabled (drive/engine degraded by 1 level); disabled systems hit again are destroyed.

action.notes: Called-shot system damage is separate from vehicle hit points.

action.name: Called Shot: External System
action.keywords: called shot vehicle external system sensors weapons gunnery

test.bonusstring: Fire One Weapon targeting an external system at -4. If damage gets through, the system is disabled (drive/engine degraded by 1 level); disabled systems hit again are destroyed.

action.name: Called Shot: Internal Compartment
action.keywords: called shot vehicle internal compartment gunnery

test.bonusstring: Fire One Weapon targeting an internal compartment at -6. If damage gets through, the system is disabled (drive/engine degraded by 1 level); disabled systems hit again are destroyed.

action.name: Called Shot: Internal System
action.keywords: called shot vehicle internal system drive engine reactor gunnery

test.bonusstring: Fire One Weapon targeting an internal system at -8. If damage gets through, the system is disabled (drive/engine degraded by 1 level); disabled systems hit again are destroyed.

action.name: Called Shot: Person's Limb
action.keywords: called shot person limb arm leg human gunnery vehicle weapon

test.bonusstring: Fire One Weapon targeting a specific limb of a person at -2.

action.notes: Additional -2 if shooting from a relatively moving vehicle, and -6 if shooting at a person from engagement range on the space combat scale.

action.name: Called Shot: Person's Head
action.keywords: called shot person head headshot human gunnery vehicle weapon

test.bonusstring: Fire One Weapon targeting a person's head at -4.

action.notes: Additional -2 if shooting from a relatively moving vehicle, and -6 if shooting at a person from engagement range on the space combat scale.

action.name: Called Shot: Person's Organ
action.keywords: called shot person organ heart vital human gunnery vehicle weapon

test.bonusstring: Fire One Weapon targeting a specific organ of a person at -6.

action.notes: Additional -2 if shooting from a relatively moving vehicle, and -6 if shooting at a person from engagement range on the space combat scale.

action.name: Above and Beyond
action.keywords: above and beyond push extra action help ship crew heroic general

test.bonusstring: Pick an attribute and skill and explain how you use them to help the ship; if the GM agrees, roll against difficulty 6. On a success the department gains an additional action; on a failure it loses the action.

action.notes: Attribute and skill are chosen by the player at the table; the formula cannot know them.

action.name: Deal With System Damage
action.keywords: deal with system damage fix repair deteriorating damage general

test.dice: {Chosen Attribute} + {Relevant Skill} v. system damage difficulty
test.bonusstring: Explain how you fix the damage and roll the relevant skill check; on a success the damage difficulty is reduced by your hits (0 difficulty = fixed).

action.notes: Difficulty = net hits the system took, +1 for every turn it was ignored (at 12 it becomes catastrophic / the system is destroyed), plus or minus 2 depending on the situation and the effectiveness of your action. Can also be used to aid another PC resolving the damage.

action.name: Pilot Program Check
action.keywords: pilot program drone autopilot piloting check device rating

test.bonusstring: A vehicle's or drone's pilot program rolls device rating x2 for its piloting checks.

action.notes: Book says "device rating*2"; the vehicle's Pilot rating is used as the device rating. Pilot initiative is Pilot x2 + 4d6.

action.name: Autosoft Task
action.keywords: autosoft drone program task crew replacement

test.bonusstring: An autosoft rolls its rating plus the pilot rating to achieve its task.

action.notes: Autosoft rating is not known to the formula engine; enter it manually. Each autosoft can replace one crew member and acts in one department only.

action.name: Astral Drill
action.keywords: astral drill jump hyperspace ftl spike drive starship travel navigation interstellar

test.bonusstring: Roll pilot + Aerospace against the drill difficulty to enter astral space and travel to another star. On a failure the ship may be lost in astral space (roll 3d6 on the consequence table).

action.notes: Base difficulty 5; course totally uncharted +4; map older than 5 years +2; map 1-5 years old +1; map less than a year old +0; map less than a month old -2; +1 per 2 full hexes of distance; trimming the course +2; rushed activation +2. Consumes 1 fuel cell. Transit time is six days to the nearest star divided by drive rating (trimming adds +1 effective drive rating). The book's "pilot + Aerospace" is interpreted as Reaction + Pilot Aerospace.
